migrations.purpose: Creates the location-scoped normalized schema and the snapshot bridge.
migrations.rollback: Do not drop tables in a live project; disable normalized reads and return to snapshot mode.

migrations.purpose: Stores employee profile updates independently of whole-schedule saves.
migrations.rollback: Keep the rows and disable profile override reads if a rollback is needed.

migrations.purpose: Adds stable employee legacy identity and ordered default availability windows.
migrations.rollback: Stop normalized employee writes; the snapshot remains the compatibility source.

migrations.purpose: Adds stable role legacy identity and explicit trainer capability support.
migrations.rollback: Stop normalized role capability writes; do not drop the additive column.

migrations.purpose: Adds employee scheduling preferences, general meal qualifications, and structured weekly work rules.
migrations.rollback: Stop normalized preference reads/writes; retain additive columns and rows while the snapshot remains active.

migrations.purpose: Adds stable legacy identity and metadata bridge columns for shifts, open shifts, request-offs, blocks, templates, and template shifts before Sandbox-only data copy work.
migrations.rollback: Do not drop additive columns; leave schedule reads on the snapshot and stop normalized schedule writes.

migrations.purpose: Adds a location-scoped optimistic revision lock before normalized schedule tables become an authoritative write source.
migrations.rollback: Keep the revision row and disable direct normalized writes; the snapshot bridge remains available.

migrations.purpose: Archives the previous complete scheduler snapshot on every whole-schedule update so compatibility rollback has durable restore points.
migrations.rollback: Disable the archive trigger if necessary; retain existing history rows for recovery.

migrations.purpose: Adds an inactive service-only PostgreSQL procedure that writes one complete normalized schedule and its revision in a single transaction.
migrations.rollback: Do not call the procedure; continue using the snapshot bridge while retaining the additive function for audit and recovery.

migrations.purpose: Links staff authentication accounts to employees.
migrations.rollback: Disable staff account routes and leave account rows intact for auditability.

migrations.purpose: Adds staff-owned contact and communication preferences.
migrations.rollback: Disable staff profile writes; preserve saved contact data.

migrations.purpose: Creates saved availability definitions, their time windows, effective-dated week assignments, and reminder history.
migrations.rollback: Keep pattern records intact and return availability reads to the snapshot bridge if verification fails.

migrations.purpose: Adds staff request-off and compatibility submission queues while saved availability is normalized through pattern assignments.
migrations.rollback: Disable approval routes and preserve workflow records.

migrations.purpose: Separates reusable availability profiles from effective-dated repeat and approval assignments without changing the snapshot read path.
migrations.rollback: Leave the additive columns and indexes in place, disable normalized availability reads and writes, and continue using the snapshot bridge.
